text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- The first industrial investment by wood products group Sonae Industria in Brazil has received the approval of the local authorities there. Sonae Industria has signed an agreement to build a factory in Parana state. The $130 million investment should eventually create more than 1,000 jobs.

- The government has prepared the decree-law governing the privatisation of a 13.2 percent stake in Banco Totta e Acores, which should take place in November, Under-Secretary of State for Finance Teixeira Santos said in Washington.
- Insurance company Mundial Confianca is the most attractive company in the Portuguese insurance sector, according to a study by Lisbon broker Midas.
- Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco dismisses International Monetary Fund (IMF) recommendations for Portugal and says there will be no civil service job cuts and no rises in Value Added Tax.
- Portuguese government wants to avoid sanctions from the European Comission because of its delay to implement a new EU law to reduce the sulphur content of diesel.
